title: Small quotient category by parallel-arrow relations
statement: Fix a Grothendieck universe $\mathcal U$ as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $C$ be a category [def-nagata-category] whose objects and morphisms form $\mathcal U$-small sets, and let $r_{x,y}$ be any binary relation on $C(x,y)$ for each pair of objects. Let $\sim$ denote the least family of equivalence relations on the sets $C(x,y)$ containing $r$ and stable under precomposition and postcomposition by every morphism of $C$. There is a $\mathcal U$-small category $C/r$ with the same objects (up to the canonical type synonym), with $(C/r)(x,y)=C(x,y)/{\sim}$, with identity $[1_x]$, and with composition $[g]\circ[f]=[g\circ f]$. The maps $x\mapsto x$, $f\mapsto[f]$ define a functor $q:C\to C/r$, and $q(f)=q(g)$ if and only if $f\sim g$ for parallel morphisms $f,g$.
